description: This file contains utility functions for validating the structure of question objects used in a quiz or exam application. It ensures that questions have the required fields, options are correctly formatted, and the correct answer is within the valid range.

methods.name: tuple[bool,List[str]] validate_question_structure(question: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Validates the structure of a question dictionary to ensure it contains all required fields, options are properly formatted with keys A-D, and the correct answer is within the accepted choices.
